decision: M2.2 full serializer was admitted after M2.1 and M2.3-M2.7 upstream contracts reached their stated local calibration gates, then implemented with a versioned envelope, atomic shadow commit, readback equality, v1/v2 replay and information-loss fail-closed corpus. M2.2 completion is evidenced by the M2.2 fixture and later contributes to M2.10 deterministic-shadow closeout.

ready_inputs.serializer_requirement: reject any input that does not pass the full 10-20 cell validation policy

ready_inputs.artifact: immutable exact PackResolution snapshot and pack lifecycle lineage
ready_inputs.serializer_requirement: persist every resolved Universal/Sector/Report-Type/Case Delta version reference and snapshot digest
persist the decision rationale and fail if a selected pack cannot be resolved exactly

ready_inputs.artifact: ComposedDecisionCell, origin-pack, merge/split/dedupe, fact-to-slot, WWC and counterevidence lineage
ready_inputs.serializer_requirement: preserve composition lineage while materializing canonical Cell and Slot versions
materialize explicit typed gaps; never erase a gap through a silent substitute
retain legacy item identity and semantic mapping review as lineage, never claim one-to-one equivalence

required_full_serializer_contract: versioned DecisionSurface artifact envelope containing contract, Cell, Slot, Gap, compiler observations and all upstream lineage
deterministic content digest covering normalized envelope fields and exact resolved pack snapshot
atomic shadow-only commit with no partial canonical object visibility on failure
readback equality that verifies envelope digest, parent/version links, pack refs, selection rationale, composition lineage, slot policy, typed gaps and legacy migration review
multi-version and snapshot replay corpus proving immutable historical reads and information-loss fail-closed behavior
explicit_nonclaims: No model, paid provider, external evidence retrieval, Writer, full-chain run or runtime cutover is admitted.
Legacy TaskRun remains authoritative and DecisionSurface remains shadow-only.
